Details 
 This western shirt is crafted from crisp, lightweight 100% cotton poplin and features an exclusive Sand Medallion print. It has a one point ultra deep curved back yoke, three snap cuffs, the Stetson “S” embroidered on the front left pocket, and “STETSON” embroidered on the right sleeve placket. The classic snap front features logo pearl snaps and is finished with solid poplin contrast inside trim.

- Stetson "S" Embroidered On Chest
- "STETSON" Embroidered On Right Sleeve Placket
- Solid Poplin Inside Trim
- 3 Snap Cuff
- Classic Snap Front With Logo Pearl Snaps
